quota_usage.method_quota: Weekly quota %: each time an account's weekly percentage rises by 1%, the rise is split among the requests through the proxy since, weighted by tokens and model price (output 5×, cache write 2×, cache read 0.1×; Opus and Fable 5×, Sonnet 3×). Providers report whole percents, so a session's figure can be off by about 1%. A rise those requests cannot explain counts as not matched to a request: most likely use outside the proxy, possibly an error of the estimate. A rise read across the start of a 7 or 30 day range that no request explains is left out, as it may have come before.
quota_usage.method_total: Total: each account is worked out on its own week and the results are added up, in units of one account's weekly quota, so the total runs to the number of accounts × 100%.
quota_usage.method_range: 7 and 30 days: each account's readings are followed across every weekly window the range touches, and what was used inside the range is added up. The unit stays one account's weekly quota, so a range can pass 100%. Use found at the first reading counts only when its week began inside the range. Quota readings start when logging began; days before that show tokens recovered from the Claude Code transcripts of the machine that runs the proxy.
